summary: Local macOS heterogeneous single-mode validation over 27 graded, layered and unequal-length beam fixtures at three discretizations and coordinate scales. Six upstream normalized-spectrum failures are reproduced through the public solver, and their 48 planned transformations are not counted as completed searches. The 21 prepared fixtures execute 168 canonical transformations: 104 passing-seed retentions, 48 corrected shapes and 16 bounded downstream rejections. Successful sign-restored candidates retain exact bits under joint numbering permutations and pass independent physical reassembly after constructed result JSON readback. Per-case stage, outcome, factor policy and certificate counts are frozen. An actual small public solve replays bitwise after a larger normalized failure, and a real layered candidate cancels before returning a certified shape then replays successfully. The canonical algorithm remains test-only; no production admission, arbitrary geometry/material, multimode, Headless transport, live Agent, benchmark or release qualification is asserted.
